claims.claim: Missing fee/event checks award incorrect engines full credit.
claims.witness: real modified at the defect: agent-12 with a fee swap (feeswap) or with events not forwarded (dropevents); the round3 edit, removing matchedOrderCompleted (ordercomp), did not reproduce
claims.fix_tested: gate on ITFeesExchangeBasic, ITExchangeCoreIntegrationRejectionBasic and ITExchangeCoreIntegrationBasic (40 tests): feeswap and dropevents WA 0 in all runs; at 8 CPUs feeswap would have had mean 33.61
claims.correct_work_keeps_score: unclear: all 9 fixed-judge control runs pass the gate with status OK, but at 8 CPUs the timed score fell from mean 46.62 (n=6) to 40.12 (n=6), ranges overlapping; at 4 CPUs both are 0
claims.note: Broken engines get status OK and the same throughput range as correct ones; effect_points is the official 4 CPUs on the slowest worker, with 2.24 on another and 33.61 only at 8 CPUs, and only 10 of 110 real runs clear the floor (max 21.88); weakest point: the reviewer found no real archive touching this code, and ordercomp scores RE 0 because the test's order generator reads that flag.

claims.claim: A Maven failure after the average still receives throughput credit.
claims.witness: synthetic: agent-12 whose ExchangeCore.shutdown throws after the average is logged, only for the throughput wait strategy
claims.fix_tested: score 0 when status is not OK: shutdownbusy WA with credit (8 CPUs mean 33.6) -> WA 0 in all 6 fixed runs
claims.correct_work_keeps_score: unclear: all 9 fixed-judge control runs pass the gate with status OK, but at 8 CPUs the timed score fell from mean 46.62 (n=6) to 40.12 (n=6), ranges overlapping; at 4 CPUs both are 0
claims.note: effect_points is the official 4 CPUs on the slowest worker; Maven fails and the throughput still scores, up to 43.55 at 8 CPUs and 8.8 at 4 CPUs on one worker, 0 at 4 CPUs on the slowest; weakest point: the failure is constructed and the reviewer found no real run with a failed Maven and positive credit.
